method: Per-card editorial review of the pending depth-v2 suffix 16..60 against the sealed source fragment, the reviewed Russian translation and the visible quote-v4 title. Each entry records whether the quotation reads as a self-contained thought and, where an opening genuinely depends on an antecedent, binds that exception to the exact visible title for that one publication. Retrieval classes record what happened at the HTTP layer only; a failed automated fetch is never treated as evidence that a quotation or its source is invalid.
